title: Avoid cloning every terminal delegation before acceptance receipt repair checks
outcome: Terminal delegation reads reject nonmatching receipt-repair cases before copying their complete records or histories.
acceptance: The receipt projection repair checks evaluator mode, Failed status, Recorded submission and absence of an in-flight submission using a borrowed delegation before any complete-record clone.
Recorded receipt recovery still repairs the exact host unconfirmed result while genuine transport failures and ordinary terminal delegations retain their previous public behavior.
Focused behavioral validation covers the matching recovery and nonmatching cases without a Markdown or implementation-text test.
